audit_items.proof_trace: `mint_ctokens` uses `float::int_div(collateral_amount, exchange_rate)` which computes `WAD * deposit / exchange_rate.value` — Move u256 integer division truncates toward zero (equals floor for positive values), yielding `floor(deposit / exchange_rate)`. `burn_ctokens` uses `exchange_rate.int_mul(ctokens.value())` = `exchange_rate.value * ctokens / WAD`, also floored, yielding `floor(ctoken * exchange_rate)`. Both operations satisfy the assertion exactly.
